bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 170, Number 155 (Friday, October 11, 2024)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Mr. POCAN:
H.R. 9985.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
Article 1, Section 8 of the U.S. Constitution.
The single subject of this legislation is:
Corporate Financial Regulation
[Page H5868]

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on Ways and Means, and in addition to the Committees on Financial Services, the Judiciary, and Education and the Workforce, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.

bill.title: Stop Wall Street Looting Act
